content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Usdt payment

The solution to this problem is not a workaround but a base-layer infrastructure that provides digital creators with a fully operational online store with automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership. This infrastructure is built on top of free tools like GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages, Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, and Google Drive, along with NOWPayments, a payment gateway that supports over 300 cryptocurrencies with a flat fee of 0.5%.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture is designed to be modular, with each component working together seamlessly to provide a seamless user experience. Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages handle hosting, while Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script manage backend logic. Supabase or Google Sheets store order information, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 handle file delivery. NOWPayments is integrated to handle automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, eliminating the need for payment gateways like Stripe or PayPal.
Who This Is Built For and Why

The product types that work with automated crypto delivery are any digital files that can be stored and delivered via download link: ebooks in PDF or EPUB format, courses packaged as ZIP archives, Notion templates exported as files or share links, font families as ZIP archives of OTF and TTF files, Lightroom or Capture One preset packs, beat files as WAV or MP3 archives, plugin installers, stock photo packs, software license keys, and any other file-based product. The delivery system in Stack 01 uses Google Drive shared links. Stack 02 uses Cloudflare R2 presigned URLs with configurable expiry times — typically 24 to 72 hours — which prevents download links from being shared indefinitely after a single purchase.
Sovereign digital commerce infrastructure provides full data ownership and automatic crypto payment processing.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The order management layer gives you complete visibility into every transaction your store processes. In Stack 01, every order is logged to a Google Sheet with the buyer's email, product purchased, payment amount in crypto and USD equivalent, transaction hash for on-chain verification, and delivery status. In Stack 02, orders are stored in a Supabase PostgreSQL database with the same fields plus additional metadata. Both can be exported as CSV at any time. The transaction hash provides cryptographic proof of every payment that does not depend on any platform's records — you can verify any transaction independently on a public blockchain explorer.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Scaling a sovereign digital store requires no infrastructure changes at any realistic volume level for most individual creators. Cloudflare Workers processes each webhook event independently — ten simultaneous orders are handled as ten separate processes with no queue congestion. Supabase handles hundreds of concurrent database operations on the free tier. Resend delivers 3,000 emails per month on the free tier — enough for significant daily sales volume. Cloudflare Pages serves the storefront to any number of concurrent visitors without capacity constraints. NOWPayments processes payment volume without per-transaction approval delays.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The most important question a reader would ask is 'How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?' The answer is simple: use a sovereign digital commerce infrastructure that provides automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership. This infrastructure is built on top of free tools like GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages, Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, and Google Drive, along with NOWPayments, a payment gateway that supports over 300 cryptocurrencies with a flat fee of 0.5%.
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies with a flat fee of 0.5%.

If you're looking for a way to sell ebooks, courses, templates, and other digital products without relying on conventional payment platforms, this post provides a comprehensive overview of the infrastructure required to achieve this. The Complete Builder Kit, available for instant download at $197, provides everything you need to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack. You can also visit our shop at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to purchase the Sovereign Starter Stack or Edge Commerce Stack and get started today.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack, follow these concrete steps: Determine your infrastructure requirements and select the components that best fit your needs; Configure GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages, or another hosting platform to host your online store; Set up Cloudflare Workers, Google Apps Script, or another backend logic provider to manage order processing and product delivery; Integrate NOWPayments to handle automatic on-chain crypto payment verification; Configure Supabase or Google Sheets to store order information and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 to handle file delivery; Test your infrastructure to ensure seamless user experience and automatic payment processing.
Frequently Asked Questions
What is the fee difference between Gumroad and NOWPayments?
Gumroad charges 10% on every sale, while NOWPayments charges a flat fee of 0.5%. At 100 sales per month on a $97 product, the fee difference retains $921.
Can I sell digital products without relying on conventional payment platforms?

Yes, you can use a sovereign digital commerce infrastructure that provides automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership. This infrastructure is built on top of free tools like GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages, Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, and Google Drive, along with NOWPayments, a payment gateway that supports over 300 cryptocurrencies with a flat fee of 0.5%.
How do I integrate NOWPayments with my existing infrastructure?

Integration is straightforward, and we provide detailed documentation and support to ensure a seamless process. Simply configure NOWPayments to handle automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, and you're ready to go.
What are the recommended networks for low fees?
The recommended networks for low fees are BSC, Solana, and TRON, with transaction fees under $0.10.
Can I use this infrastructure to sell physical products?
No, this infrastructure is designed specifically for digital products, and it's not suitable for physical products.
